entries.name: isis-cast
entries.prompt: Edit our original Isis reference into a stationary LASER CASTER ready pose. Preserve exact adult face, bronze skin, anime cel shading, indigo hair, gold solar crown, ivory turquoise gold costume, leggings and sandals. Full body, square transparent canvas. Feet planted apart, both soles on fixed ground level, no stepping. Three-quarter facing RIGHT. Hold the SAME ankh staff with BOTH HANDS at waist/chest height, diagonally across body: butt end toward lower left and ANKH CRYSTAL HEAD toward upper right, beyond right shoulder, clearly separated from face. She aims and channels magic through the ankh crystal, NOT a melee fighter. Focused confident expression, elbows naturally bent, restrained hair and cloth. This is a clean character-only animation input, NO beam, glow, aura, particles, motion streak, scenery, text, ground or shadow. Entire crown feet and both staff ends visible with generous empty margin, subject central 60% of square height. True transparent alpha background.

entries.name: isis-laser
entries.prompt: ONE standalone horizontal laser beam VFX asset for a bright anime fantasy game, true transparent background. Beam travels LEFT TO RIGHT, straight along horizontal centerline. Bright ivory-white narrow core, saturated turquoise outer glow, thin warm gold edging and a few restrained gold sparks. Compact bright emitter spark at LEFT end; narrow consistent shaft ending in a tapered luminous tip toward RIGHT. Clean cel-style graphic energy, not a curved slash, no ring around beam, no character or weapon, no text, no background or ground. Wide landscape 3:1 image. Entire beam visible, 10% transparent margin on each end, plenty of transparent space above and below. This will be independently positioned at a magical staff tip and rotated by game code.
